questions.history: Encode these documents in UTF-32BE. Repeat in UTF-32LE.
questions.prediction: The issue reports loss or corruption of a low surrogate when the pair is split. After, every prefix and byte order must produce exactly the two requested supplementary scalars at the tail.
questions.basis: U+1F600 has UTF-16 units D83D DE00 and U+10000 has D800 DC00. Endianness changes the input bytes only.
questions.refutation: A replacement, missing or unpaired surrogate, different code point, or missing END_ARRAY on the merge.
